hypotheses.statement: Any film with ≥30% Sn degrades fast from Sn(II) oxidation.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 400 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Sn2+ oxidation is the dominant failure mode of Sn perovskites.
critiques: Too broad: region covers 73% of the space; a pass/fail says little about mechanism.
Conflicts with supported H11 on 64 shared compositions.

hypotheses.statement: Br-rich mixed halides without Cs segregate and lose stability.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 250 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Light-induced halide segregation.

hypotheses.statement: Cs/FA double-cation Pb iodides are the stable baseline.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure <= 600 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Entropic stabilisation of the black phase.

hypotheses.statement: MA-majority films are thermally unstable.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 250 h.
hypotheses.rationale: MA volatilises under heat.

hypotheses.statement: Sn content near 0.4 lowers the bandgap beyond the linear-mixing expectation.
hypotheses.prediction: bandgap (eV) < 1.40 eV for Sn 0.2–0.6, Br ≤ 0.1, FA ≥ 0.6
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure >= 1.40 eV.
hypotheses.rationale: Cs0.1FA0.9Pb0.6Sn0.4I3 measured Eg 1.30 eV vs prior Eg 1.48 eV (z = -2.2); ridge attribution points to Sn (weight 0.02).

hypotheses.statement: Cs content near 0.2 raises stability in Sn 0.2–0.6 films beyond literature expectation.
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if ≥⅔ of ≥3 films in the region measure <= 327 h.
hypotheses.rationale: Cs0.2FA0.8Pb0.6Sn0.4I3 measured T80 581 h vs prior T80 157 h (z = 1.4); ridge attribution points to Cs (weight 0.01).

hypotheses.statement: In Sn 0.2–0.6 films, adding Cs (≥0.1) raises T80 by more than 2×.
hypotheses.prediction: log10 T80 (h) is higher by >0.25 in [Sn 0.2–0.6, Br ≤ 0.1, FA ≥ 0.6, Cs ≥ 0.1] than in [Sn 0.2–0.6, Br ≤ 0.1, Cs = 0]
hypotheses.kill_condition: False if, after ≥2 films per arm, the difference is below a third of the predicted effect.
hypotheses.rationale: Contrast test isolates the driver from Sn content.

hypotheses.statement: FA content near 0.9 raises stability in Sn 0.2–0.6 films beyond literature expectation.

hypotheses.rationale: Cs0.1FA0.9Pb0.6Sn0.4I3 measured T80 217 h vs prior T80 157 h (z = 0.3); ridge attribution points to FA (weight 0.05).

hypotheses.kill_condition: False if, after ≥2 films per arm, the difference is below a third of the predicted effect.

literature.claim: Single-junction efficiency peaks for absorbers near 1.34 eV (detailed-balance limit ≈33.7%).
Mixed Sn-Pb iodide perovskites show anomalous bandgap bowing: mixed films absorb further into the IR than either end member.
literature.source: Hao et al., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 136, 8094 (2014)

literature.claim: FA/Cs Sn-Pb (≈50% Sn) films reach ≈1.2-1.25 eV and serve as low-gap tandem subcells.
Sn(II) readily oxidises to Sn(IV), creating p-doping and fast degradation; stability drops with Sn content.
literature.source: Noel et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 7, 3061 (2014)

literature.claim: Mixed I/Br films phase-segregate under illumination (Hoke effect) when Br ≳ 20%.
Adding a small fraction of Cs to FA/MA perovskites improves phase stability and reproducibility.
literature.source: Saliba et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 9, 1989 (2016)
